summary.text: Flavia DeBrito is a Democratic state representative from Maine who has represented District 64 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A community organizer, she has also served on the Waterville City Council.

paragraphs.text: Flavia DeBrito earned a bachelor's degree from Thomas College in 2020, and her career experience includes working as a community organizer.
Ballotpedia notes that, as of 2024, she served as a Waterville City Council member and was affiliated with Maine State Parents Ambassadors and Educare.
She assumed office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Colleen Madigan.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, DeBrito described herself as a mother, small business owner and advocate who had served as a Ward 2 councilor in Waterville for five years.
She listed her campaign messages as increasing revenue sharing for economic development, supporting schools, and improving access to mental health care.
